files.shared/data/devices.json: One entry per live instrument: port, parser, rules, capture and field maps
files.shared/data/kits.json: Every bridge kit: its parts, flow, install steps, checks and safeguards, with example parts
files.shared/data/catalog.json: Every planned instrument, ranked by value to a DEA-registered lab
files.shared/data/targets.json: Target systems: endpoint, reference prefix and required fields
files.server/data/ledger.json: Controlled-substance containers and their opening balances
files.tools/repo-files.ts: Walks the repo: checked directories, entries and markdown files
files.tools/agents-md.ts: Pure helper: which directories lack AGENTS.md
files.tools/check-agents-md.ts: Script that runs the AGENTS.md check and sets the exit code
files.tools/docs/: Docs generator: fills generated blocks and checks references
files.tools/docs/markers.ts: Finds generated blocks in markdown and fills them from renderers
files.tools/docs/facts.ts: Computes demo figures by running the real pipeline and server handler
files.tools/docs/renderers.ts: One renderer per generated block name
files.tools/docs/references.ts: Finds npm scripts and file paths that a doc names
files.tools/docs/notes.ts: Schema and stale-note check for notes.json
files.tools/docs/notes.json: Descriptions for files and npm scripts, shown in generated tables
files.tools/docs/sync.ts: Script: writes or checks every generated block
files.tools/docs/glossary.ts: Spells initialisms out and finds bare ones in a doc
files.tools/docs/glossary.json: Every initialism: its expansion and its meaning
files.design/tokens.json: The source for every colour, font, radius, shadow and timing, with a dark value for each colour and shadow
files.design/contrast.json: The colour pairs that must stay readable in both themes, with the least contrast ratio of each
files.design/layout.json: Breakpoints and the compact drawing zoom
files.design/viewports.json: The window sizes the fit check opens
files.design/components.json: One recipe for each UI component: selector, parts, states and tokens
files.design/principles.json: The rules about the look that tokens cannot state
files.design/schema.ts: Schemas that validate the spec files
files.design/files.ts: Reads the spec sources and writes or compares the generated files
files.design/css.ts: Turns the tokens into CSS custom properties, for the light and the dark theme
files.design/contrast.ts: Computes contrast ratios and finds colour pairs that are too faint in a theme
files.design/check.ts: Checks that token names are unique, components name real tokens, every colour has a dark value and every pair is readable
files.design/build.ts: Script: writes the generated files, or checks them with --check
files.design/spec.lock: Generated hash of the sources, for detecting edits in a copy
files.design/THIRD_PARTY.md: Licence notice for patterns adapted from Beautiful UI
files.tools/seo/: SEO generator: writes the discovery files, icons and home page tags from site/seo.json
files.tools/seo/assets.json: The fonts and the screenshot that the Open Graph image draws from
files.tools/seo/assets.ts: Reads those files, and names them by data URL or by hash
files.tools/seo/blocks.ts: Marker pairs in client/index.html, and the function that fills a block
files.tools/seo/body.ts: Renders the noscript block of the home page
files.tools/seo/build.ts: Script: writes the files, or checks them with --check
files.tools/seo/files.ts: The table of generated files: text files, the home page and image specs
files.tools/seo/git.ts: Finds the sitemap date from git
files.tools/seo/graphics.ts: Draws the brand mark as the favicon and as the page for each square icon
files.tools/seo/head.ts: Renders the head tags: title, description, canonical, icons, Open Graph, Twitter card and JSON-LD
files.tools/seo/html.ts: Escapes text and builds meta tags and script-safe JSON
files.tools/seo/images.ts: Plans each image: its source hash, whether it is current, and its draw job
files.tools/seo/io.ts: Reads and writes the generated files, and finds the stale ones
files.tools/seo/jsonLd.ts: Builds the JSON-LD graph of the maker and the demo
files.tools/seo/load.ts: Loads the Site from seo.json, the registry, the tokens and package.json
files.tools/seo/og.css: The style of the Open Graph image
files.tools/seo/og.ts: Renders the page that Chromium turns into the Open Graph image
files.tools/seo/plan.ts: Reads every input and plans every generated file
files.tools/seo/png.ts: Reads the PNG size, and writes and reads the source hash in a PNG text chunk
files.tools/seo/render.ts: Draws pages to PNG with Chromium
files.tools/seo/site.ts: The typed Site: seo.json joined with the facts that other sources own
files.tools/seo/urls.ts: Names of the discovery files, and absolute and root-relative URLs
files.site/seo.json: The source of the discovery copy: title, description, summary, crawlers, agent rules and links
files.site/public/: Generated public files that the build copies to the site root
files.site/send.ts: Answers the deliver request in the browser with the server handler
files.site/vite.config.ts: Vite config for the Pages build
files.site/public/agents.txt: What an automated agent may and may not do
files.site/public/apple-touch-icon.png: Icon for the iOS home screen
files.site/public/llms.txt: A plain summary of the demo for language-model crawlers
files.site/public/og.png: The Open Graph image, 1200 by 630 px
files.site/public/robots.txt: The crawler rules, and the sitemap link
files.site/public/sitemap.xml: The sitemap, with the date of the last change
files.site/dropNotes.ts: Vite plugin: removes AGENTS.md from the build output

scripts.build: Typechecks, then builds the client into dist/
scripts.build:pages: Builds the static site for GitHub Pages, with the delivery API in the browser
scripts.check: Typecheck, lint, test, check the drawings, build and build the static site
scripts.design: Writes design/tokens.css, SPEC.md and spec.lock from the JSON sources
scripts.dev: Starts the app and the API, and prints the one tailnet link
scripts.docs: Rewrites every generated block from its source
scripts.drawings: Draws every instrument and kit under Node, and fails when a part or a builder is missing
scripts.fit: Builds the static site, opens it at nine window sizes, and fails when the page scrolls, a region is clipped, a control is too small to tap, or the layout budget breaks
scripts.health: Checks that the dev server answers
scripts.lint: ESLint, the AGENTS.md check and the docs check
scripts.media: Builds the static site, records it, and writes the README screenshot and GIF
scripts.proof: Renders every instrument and kit drawing to proof/
scripts.seo: Writes the discovery files, icons and home page tags from site/seo.json

spoken.fills: One value with its initialisms spelled out

term.fills: The expansion and the initialism in parentheses

glossary.fills: A table of every initialism and its meaning

files.fills: A table of its entries, with notes from `notes.json`

dirs.fills: A table of the top-level directories, from each `AGENTS.md`

scripts.fills: A table of the npm scripts, with notes from `notes.json`

catalog.fills: The instrument catalogue and each status
